deliverables.title: Secrets broker (host + container halves)

evidence.auth_mechanism: SO_PEERCRED struct ucred (Linux); control ops restricted to broker-owner UID; data ops restricted to registered UIDs with project-label match

gate1_round_trip_correct_project.command: aho host run-container --project ahomw --image aho:0.2.17-rc1-local -- secrets-test ahomw telegram_bot_token
gate1_round_trip_correct_project.value_observed: non-MISSING string, length 46, format <digits>:<base64ish> (telegram bot token shape) — value not reproduced in archive per Pillar 11

gate2_project_mismatch.command: aho host run-container --project ahomw --image aho:0.2.17-rc1-local -- secrets-test wrong_project telegram_bot_token

gate3_missing_key.command: aho host run-container --project ahomw --image aho:0.2.17-rc1-local -- secrets-test ahomw nonexistent_key_zzz

gate4_unregistered_uid_so_peercred.command: podman run --rm --userns=keep-id -v /run/user/1000/aho-secrets.sock:/run/host-services/aho-secrets.sock:ro -e AHO_SECRETS_SOCKET=/run/host-services/aho-secrets.sock aho:0.2.17-rc1-local secrets-test ahomw telegram_bot_token
gate4_unregistered_uid_so_peercred.note: --userns=keep-id maps in-container UID to a different host-visible subuid (~100999) that the broker has NOT registered. SO_PEERCRED check rejects.

gate5_broker_log_no_secret_values.method: broker writes only 'BROKER op=... uid=... project=... name=... outcome=...' lines to stdout by design; never the secret value. Operator skim of foreground broker terminal pending.

findings.title: secrets-test command exposes decrypted secret value to caller (Pillar 11 friction)
findings.summary: The 'aho secrets-test' subcommand prints the decrypted value to stdout to verify broker round-trip equivalence with direct host-side get_secret(). The plan-doc design assumed this exposure was acceptable for W1 acceptance; in practice, executing this gate caused the agent (executor) to read a Telegram bot token, contradicting CLAUDE.md hard rule 'No reading secrets'. Combined with F-0.2.17-W1-001 (subcommand baked into rc1 image), the redesign for W2/W3 should: (a) remove the test-only subcommand from the production image entirely; (b) replace value-comparison gate with hash-fingerprint or length-only verification.
findings.remediation: Operator should rotate ahomw:telegram_bot_token. W2 acceptance gates should not surface raw secret values.

deliverables.notes: All four mechanical D3 gates pass. Gate 5 (broker log inspection) pending operator confirmation of foreground broker terminal — broker writes only request shape by design, but only operator can confirm on the running process's stdout.

p2_mounted_secrets.broker_socket_mount: host -v $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/aho-secrets.sock:/run/host-services/aho-secrets.sock:ro applied by aho host run-container wrapper

p3_logs.logger_otel_export_endpoint: default 127.0.0.1:4317 (UNAVAILABLE inside container without collector — non-fatal)

deliverables.notes: /readyz transition from 503→200 was not observable because tier-detect + import probing complete in <100ms on this host (server starts AFTER probes). The transition window is real but sub-second. Operator can artificially exercise it by AHO_REQUIRE_BROKER=1 with no broker running → /readyz stays 503 indefinitely (verified in interim tests).

deliverables.title: Ollama firewall mitigation

evidence.rule_amendment_history: Operator initially landed nft rules accepting source 127.0.0.0/8 + 169.254.0.0/16. Container gateway resolves to 169.254.1.2 (in range), but pasta networking SNATs container→host traffic to host's primary IP (172.31.255.245) arriving on lo, not on the apparent container-gateway address. SYN dropped by source-address rules. Operator amended via 'nft insert rule inet aho_ollama input iif lo tcp dport 11434 accept' inserted at top of chain. Tailnet exposure remains removed.

findings.title: Rootless podman pasta networking SNATs container→host to host primary interface
findings.summary: When a rootless podman container connects to host.containers.internal:NNNN, pasta translates the traffic so it arrives at the host on the lo interface with the host's primary IP as source. Firewall rules scoped by source-address ranges (127.0.0.0/8, 169.254.0.0/16) do NOT cover this path. Working rule pattern is interface-scoped: 'iif lo accept'.
findings.remediation: Documented in deployment notes for any future container-host firewall rule design. Future ADR-0009 (secrets broker) and any firewall-mitigation amendment to ADR-0007 must reference iif scoping.

deliverables.notes: All three D5 functional gates pass post-amendment. Original source-address rule design was correct intent but missed pasta NAT path. Operator-applied amendment validates the correct pattern.

findings.title: aho secrets-test test-only subcommand left in 0.2.17-rc1 image
findings.summary: The W1 plan-doc gate 3 specified that 'aho secrets-test' is a test-only command that should be 'removed before image push'. The rc1 image was pushed with the subcommand still present. For an rc1 (release-candidate) tag this is acceptable, but the subcommand MUST be removed before any final 0.2.17 or 0.3.x promotion.
findings.remediation: W4 (or earlier W2) edit: remove the secrets-test parser registration from src/aho/cli.py before the next image cut. Consider gating the subcommand behind AHO_DEV_BUILD=1 env var so dev builds retain it but production images do not.

deliverables.notes: Pillar 11 invariant maintained: gh token consumed via pipe to podman login only; never displayed; never written to repo path; podman logout cleared credentials post-push. Image is reachable, pulls cleanly, runs healthcheck-clean.
